questions.question: Expand: (2x + 3)(x + 4)
questions.explanation: Using FOIL: First 2x·x = 2x², Outer 2x·4 = 8x, Inner 3·x = 3x, Last 3·4 = 12. Sum: 2x² + 8x + 3x + 12 = 2x² + 11x + 12.
questions.fastStrategy: FOIL: multiply First, Outer, Inner, Last terms, then combine like terms.

questions.question: Expand: (x - 5)²
questions.explanation: (x - 5)² = (x - 5)(x - 5) = x² - 5x - 5x + 25 = x² - 10x + 25. Or use pattern (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b².
questions.fastStrategy: Perfect square pattern: (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b².

questions.question: Expand: (2x - 3)(2x + 3)
questions.explanation: This is a difference of squares: (a - b)(a + b) = a² - b². Here, a = 2x, b = 3, so (2x)² - 3² = 4x² - 9.
steps: 1. Recognize pattern (a - b)(a + b) = a² - b².
questions.fastStrategy: Difference of squares: (a - b)(a + b) = a² - b²; middle terms cancel.

questions.question: Simplify: 3(x + 2) - 2(x - 1)
questions.fastStrategy: Distribute each coefficient to all terms in parentheses; combine like terms.

questions.question: Expand: (x + 2)³
questions.fastStrategy: For (a + b)³: build from (a + b)², then multiply by (a + b) again.
